[[County Londonderry]] | capacity = 1,500 (274 seated) | chairman = Geoff Ferris | manager = Paul Owens | league = [[NIFL Premiership]] | season = [[2025–26 NIFL Championship|2025–26]] | position = [[NIFL Championship]], 1st of 12 (champions; promoted) | pattern_la1 = _blue_hoops | pattern_b1 = | pattern_ra1 = _blue_hoops | pattern_so1 = | pattern_sh1 = | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = 003EE1 | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = 003EE1 | socks1 = 003EE1 | pattern_la2 = _yellowhoops | pattern_b2 = | pattern_ra2 = _yellowhoops | pattern_so2 = | pattern_sh2 = | leftarm2 = 000D5B | body2 = FFF000 | rightarm2 = 000D5B | shorts2 = FFF000 | socks2 = FFF000 | website = http://www.limavadyunitedfc.com/ }} '''Limavady United Football Club''' is a semi-professional, [[Northern Ireland|Northern Irish]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club playing in the [[NIFL Championship]], the second tier of Irish football but will play in [[NIFL Premiership]] from 2026 to 2027 season after promotion in 2025–26. The club comes from [[Limavady]], [[County Londonderry]], and plays home matches at the [[The Showgrounds (Limavady)|Showgrounds]]. Club colours are royal blue shirts with white trim, blue socks and royal blue shorts. Away colours are all yellow. The current manager is Paul Owens, with assistant manager and ex player Charlie Moore."}}
